rowText: Turn ON 'Allow high-VRAM model fallbacks'. Type gemma3:27b into the custom field and press its Pull (about 17 GB). Watch the first two minutes of progress; if the projection is over 60 minutes, cancel and record BLOCKED with the measured speed. If it finishes, read text_model_routing_order: PASS if gemma3:27b is FIRST; FAIL if it is last or missing.

build.commit: 96538e1 (branch experimental, working tree at run time)

verdictSentence: Not run: naming a big model needs typing into the custom field, and typing on the Deck's on-screen keyboard cannot be seen or checked by this rig (same limit as PULL-MISSING-NAME-01), so the high-VRAM switch was never turned on and no download was started.
notes: The catalog checkboxes never reached 15 GB in this build (largest seen was gemma4:latest at 8.9 GB), so this row cannot be done with checkboxes alone - it genuinely needs the custom text field.
model_allow_high_vram_fallbacks was left at its starting value, false, since it was never touched.
